name: OpenResearch
description: Turn your coding agents into research agents
one_liner: A workspace that turns an AI coding assistant into a research assistant: it can read scientific papers, propose experiments, run them, and track what worked, like a lab notebook that also does the lab work.
buyer: A PhD student or small ML startup that needs to run many experiments but can't afford a full research team.
business_use_cases: A small ML startup runs dozens of hyperparameter and architecture experiments in parallel overnight instead of one engineer babysitting one run at a time.
A PhD researcher uses the paper-discovery command to keep a literature review current without manually trawling arXiv every week.
A research-tools consultancy sets it up on client compute clusters as a paid onboarding service for academic labs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer setup and integration consulting for academic labs connecting it to their compute clusters
Sell managed compute and hosting for labs that don't want to run their own GPUs

steal_this: This weekend, set it up against one open dataset, let it run an overnight autoresearch loop, and publish the experiment trail as a case study to attract lab customers.
